source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use tool to check PCH version
1.Boot into OS.
2. Use tool to check PCH version.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Make sure the PCH version is match with MB.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Run the vendor PCH version utility and return its reported version for comparison with the mainboard expectation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly requires the vendor utility but treats package supply as a capability limitation and leaves target/version semantics to the operator.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds exact board/PCH identity, signed read-only tool, expected-version source and no-remediation boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Confirms the read-only version purpose and rejects using a bare version string without target correlation.

original_test_intent: Read the identified platform's PCH revision or version with the approved vendor utility and verify that the target-bound value matches the motherboard definition, without modifying PCH state.
original_method: Boot the approved OS, confirm motherboard and PCH identity, run the owner-supplied read-only PCH version utility or referenced script, preserve raw output and compare the mapped value with the authoritative motherboard expectation and post-check logs.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies the target mapping, expected value and validated tool/script and later decides the verdict. These are inputs and governance actions; the core OS query, comparison and evidence capture require no inherent manual physical or visual step.
required_inputs: Exact motherboard SKU/revision, PCH device/stepping and definition of the reported 'version' field
Authoritative expected PCH value mapped to that motherboard
Signed compatible vendor utility/version/hash or reviewed referenced-script content/version
Exact read-only command, privileges, output schema and target-correlation rule
Relevant BIOS/BMC/OS inventory and log baselines
safety_requirements: Confirm the selected utility mode is read-only and bound to the intended PCH.
Do not flash, remediate or change firmware/fuse state when an unexpected value is reported.
Preserve raw output and logs; do not accept an unmapped version string or clear evidence.
Do not auto-retry an unverified utility or substitute another platform tool without owner validation.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the board/PCH/expected-value/tool/script manifest and capture platform identity.
Run the approved read-only query once, preserve stdout/stderr/exit status and correlate the reported field with the exact target.
Compare with the supplied motherboard expectation, collect post-check logs and report Tool Result without setting PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define the exact PCH field meant by 'version' and its motherboard mapping.
Approve the tool/script, access and expected value.
Review mapped evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level vendor-tool instruction is directionally correct but is not executable until exact syntax, target and output schema are supplied. Package absence alone does not make the automated core PARTIAL.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the owner-validated read-only vendor utility or reviewed referenced script, with explicit target identity, raw output and expected-value comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS boot, PCH version query, motherboard comparison, referenced script URL and 0/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: EXISTING VENDOR METHOD WITH TARGET MAPPING
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Wrap the read-only utility in structured capture of board/PCH IDs, tool/script hash, raw output, parsed field and authoritative expected mapping; produce a comparison without remediation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact motherboard/PCH/tool combination in the approved mapping.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform-owner PCH inventory specification and vendor tool documentation plus the referenced internal script; these were not available in the repository.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact field/target mapping and reproducible artifact identity without replacing the source tool.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; the reported PCH value must still match the motherboard expectation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative version-field definition and board mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different tools may expose silicon device ID, stepping or firmware-related values under the word version; only the owner mapping determines equivalence.

project_override_considerations: A project may supply its motherboard-specific expected mapping and tool version. That is a readiness input, not a master-source change, and the report must identify the exact field compared.
expected_evidence: Motherboard/PCH/BIOS identity, expected mapping, utility/script hash/version and authorization
Exact read-only invocation with stdout/stderr/exit status
Raw and parsed PCH field tied to the correct device plus explicit expected/actual comparison
Post-check OS/BMC/SEL health, no-write attestation, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require a PCH value read in the OS and comparison with the motherboard definition. The word 'version' is underspecified but can be resolved by the project mapping without contradicting the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only query and comparison are clear. Missing tool, field definition and expected value are normal readiness inputs and do not prevent an automatable execution once supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the vendor-tool dependency but corrects PARTIAL: package supply is separate from the automatable OS query.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains target identity, read-only behavior and expected mapping while advancing capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires a precise definition of the compared field and reproducible target-bound evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents an ambiguous or wrong-device version string from being accepted and separates project inputs from automation capability.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source operation is an OS-side read-only query followed by deterministic comparison and log collection. With the approved package and mapping supplied, all core actions and evidence can be automated; no physical setup or human observation is intrinsic.

no_automatic_retry: Run the approved read-only query once. Preserve any error or mismatch and escalate; do not switch utilities or attempt update/remediation automatically.
